title: WR-90, 30 mm of air, below its TE10 cut-off (6.557 GHz): the wave decays from port to port
source: A uniform guide below cut-off with its ports in it: TE10 goes as e^{−αz}, α = √((π/a)² − k0²); in the pseudo-waves of R. B. Marks and D. F. Williams (A general waveguide circuit theory, J. Res. NIST 97(5):533–562, 1992) referred to the ports' own mode, S11 = 0 and S21 = e^{−αL}, real (D. M. Pozar, Microwave Engineering, 4th ed., Wiley 2012, §3.3), evaluated separately from EMCraft's code
